background: Plans household purchases for a family and normally shops once a week.
shopping_preferences: Practical groceries, children's essentials, and durable household products; avoids gift vouchers.
typical_spending: Regular supermarket visits, public transport, and occasional family meals, mostly during daytime.
travel_pattern: One or two short trips to neighbouring countries each year.

background: Travels regularly for consulting work and separates travel spending from everyday purchases.
shopping_preferences: Flexible hotel bookings near public transport and simple expense documentation.
typical_spending: Frequent rail, hotel, and restaurant payments in Switzerland, Germany, and France.
travel_pattern: Regular business travel in Germany and France.

background: Spends weekends hiking and climbing, with seasonal trips across the nearby Italian border.
shopping_preferences: Repairable outdoor equipment and specialist sports shops rather than fashion purchases.
typical_spending: Sports purchases, fuel, casual dining, and periodic EUR transactions in northern Italy.

background: Works rotating hospital shifts and often buys meals and essentials outside standard office hours.
shopping_preferences: Fast grocery delivery and practical meals after late shifts; avoids energy drinks.
typical_spending: Groceries, meal delivery, transport, and pharmacy purchases, including legitimate late-night activity.

background: Studies part-time while working and relies on several digital learning services.
shopping_preferences: Books and learning tools with transparent prices; no automatic premium upgrades.
typical_spending: Small recurring subscriptions, book purchases, transport, and inexpensive cafés.

background: Runs and cycles throughout the year and replaces equipment only when needed.
shopping_preferences: Technical sports equipment from specialist retailers and products with clear return terms.
typical_spending: Frequent modest sports purchases with occasional higher-value shoes or cycling equipment.
travel_pattern: Weekend trips within Switzerland and Austria.

background: Is gradually renovating an apartment and plans each room as a separate project.
shopping_preferences: Simple repairable fittings, neutral colours, and click-and-collect when available.
typical_spending: Home-improvement stores, household purchases, transport, and occasional furniture deliveries.

background: Coordinates purchases for children and an older relative as well as her own household.
shopping_preferences: Reliable delivery windows, clearly sized children's items, and familiar pharmacies.
typical_spending: Groceries, family supplies, health purchases, and household orders across two cards.
travel_pattern: One family holiday in Europe each year.

background: Shares an apartment with two friends and manages a rotating household shopping list.
shopping_preferences: Shared essentials in normal pack sizes and receipts that are easy to split.
typical_spending: Groceries and household goods from recurring local merchants, plus shared meal deliveries.

background: Works independently as a designer and uses a separate card for business tools and travel.
shopping_preferences: Month-to-month software, clear invoices, and no bundled consulting services.
typical_spending: Software subscriptions, electronics, cafés, and occasional foreign-currency online services.
travel_pattern: Several European client trips each year.

background: Prefers nearby physical shops and normally pays for everyday items in person.
shopping_preferences: Local products, simple receipts, and collection from a store rather than delivery.
typical_spending: Daytime in-store groceries, transport, clothing, and occasional restaurant purchases.

background: Uses a phone wallet for most everyday purchases and keeps a separate travel card.
shopping_preferences: Mobile receipts, fast checkout, and Italian or Swiss fashion retailers with returns.
typical_spending: High mobile-wallet usage for clothing, dining, groceries, and cross-border trips.

background: Repairs products where possible and chooses refill or second-life options for routine shopping.
shopping_preferences: Reusable, refurbished, or repairable items with transparent materials.
typical_spending: Groceries, repair services, second-life goods, public transport, and few impulse purchases.

background: Attends concerts and festivals in summer but spends little on entertainment during the rest of the year.
shopping_preferences: Standard admission from clear ticket sellers; no VIP or resale upgrades.
typical_spending: Seasonal clusters of event purchases alongside normal groceries, transport, and dining.
travel_pattern: Domestic events and occasional German concerts.

background: Enjoys photography and saves for occasional equipment rather than buying accessories frequently.
shopping_preferences: Compatible camera equipment from specialist shops, with a return window and no financing.
typical_spending: Mostly modest daily spending interrupted by rare, planned high-value photography purchases.

background: Owns a dog and receives repeat deliveries of food and routine care products.
shopping_preferences: The usual pet-food formula, dependable delivery, and no unrequested supplement substitutions.
typical_spending: Recurring pet-care payments mixed with groceries, transport, health, and park-side cafés.

background: Recently moved within Switzerland and is still establishing new local shopping routines.
shopping_preferences: Practical household basics and merchants that offer clear delivery dates.
typical_spending: A wider-than-usual variety of new grocery, household, transport, and home-improvement merchants.
travel_pattern: Occasional travel to France and Sweden.

background: Keeps personal daily spending separate from a shared household account.
shopping_preferences: Predictable grocery orders, clearly separated receipts, and household staples in normal quantities.
typical_spending: Frequent groceries and transport on one card, with shared household purchases on another account.
travel_pattern: A few European city trips each year.

background: Researches online purchases carefully and uses a virtual card for web shops.
shopping_preferences: Known electronics sellers, clear warranty terms, and no marketplace add-ons.
typical_spending: Few online purchases, repeated familiar merchants, and mostly local in-store daily spending.

background: Balances a busy schedule with frequent grocery and prepared-meal deliveries.
shopping_preferences: Reliable delivery estimates, saved food preferences, and no automatic membership enrolment.
typical_spending: Frequent small ecommerce and mobile-wallet payments, especially food delivery and groceries.
